problem_statement: The gabrielhazeredo/visionai-landing-page project is a React/CRA AI vision product landing page (local logo, hero video image, feature icons, AI inspection split images, newsletter CTA, Sass section styling) built under the /visionai-landing-page/ base path. Rebrand the page as the Foundry Sight machine vision QA program and give the program a Capability finder: replace the generic process tiles with the program's own capability grid (six capabilities, each tagged to a discipline track) plus a discipline filter and a live result count so a visitor can scope the grid by Inspection intelligence, Edge deployment or 24/7 monitoring. The Capability finder must be a shared program element that also appears on the deployment playbook and evidence library pages, it must filter the shown capabilities and update its 'Showing N of 6' readout when a discipline chip is clicked, and it must stay readable and overflow-free across desktop, tablet and mobile. Keep the original hero video modal, local media, logo, split inspection-evidence images, newsletter CTA and build pipeline intact.
required_content: Keep the React/CRA build pipeline, Sass import structure, LayoutDefault, Header, Footer, Hero, FeaturesSplit, CTA, local logo, hero video image, feature icons, split images and newsletter CTA intact.
Modify source files rather than generated build output, and do not add dependencies, remote media, or new generated screenshots.
Add a Foundry Sight Capability finder that renders the six capabilities as a capability grid with a 'Machine vision QA capabilities you can audit' heading and a 'Foundry Sight program' eyebrow.
The Capability finder must include a discipline filter (All capabilities / Inspection intelligence / Edge deployment / 24/7 monitoring) and a live 'Showing N of 6' result readout.
Clicking a discipline chip must filter the shown capability cards AND update the readout, so choosing Inspection intelligence reads 'Showing 2 of 6 . Inspection intelligence'.
The Capability finder must be a shared element rendered on the home page, the deployment playbook page and the evidence library page so the capability surface stays consistent across the site.
Reuse the existing local split assets image1.png, image2.jpeg and image3.webp as the AI inspection evidence images with meaningful Foundry Sight alt text.
Keep the Capability finder readable on desktop, tablet and mobile without horizontal overflow or card overlap, and without hiding the original hero copy or newsletter CTA.
design_constraints: Do not replace the landing page with a new template, remove the hero video modal, or remove the original split inspection-evidence image sequence or newsletter input.
Use the existing dark background, green primary accent, card border radius, section spacing and Sass architecture so the Capability finder feels native to the template.
Keep the change section-scoped: the Capability finder belongs in the program's capability section and its shared playbook/evidence surfaces, not as a detached marketing banner or modal.
The discipline filter row must wrap cleanly on narrow viewports; the capability cards must stay a legible grid, never a shingled or overlapping pile.
Avoid horizontal overflow and text overlap in the Capability finder across desktop, tablet and mobile.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect benchmark-wide homepage coverage under the /visionai-landing-page/ base path.
desktop_capabilities verifies the Capability finder's discipline chips, live count readout and legible capability grid on the default desktop lever state.
mobile_capabilities and tablet_capabilities verify the discipline filter row wraps without horizontal overflow.
desktop_cap_filter clicks the Inspection intelligence chip so the readout re-scopes to 'Showing 2 of 6 . Inspection intelligence'.
desktop_playbook and desktop_evidence verify the shared Capability finder is present on the secondary program pages.
desktop_cta protects the original newsletter CTA and desktop_hero_modal opens the existing hero video modal so the original hero media interaction is not regressed.

change_completion: The Capability finder renders the six capabilities as a grid with the Foundry Sight heading, the discipline filter and a live 'Showing N of 6' readout.
Clicking a discipline chip filters the shown capability cards and updates the readout count and label.
design_consistency: The Capability finder follows the template's dark surface, green accent, card border and section spacing so it reads as part of the existing design system.
The shared finder appears consistently on the home, playbook and evidence surfaces.
responsive: The discipline filter row wraps cleanly and the capability grid stays legible on desktop, tablet and mobile.
The Capability finder never creates horizontal overflow or overlapping cards, and never covers the CTA.
regression: Hero heading, hero video modal, split inspection-evidence images, feature icons and the newsletter CTA remain present.
The build pipeline and /visionai-landing-page/ base path remain intact.
state_coverage: Captured states cover homepage desktop/mobile/tablet, the Capability finder lever, the filter interaction, the shared playbook/evidence surfaces, the CTA and the hero modal interaction.

metadata.design_goal: use real repo content, media, icons, copy and data structures without generic dummy surfaces
metadata.source_repo_kind: React CRA AI vision landing page with local logo, hero video image, feature icons, split images, Sass sections and newsletter CTA
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable AI vision product page whose own process-tiles section is a natural host for a capability filter with a live result count.

author_notes: Slot slot_260 hardens the visionai-landing-page AI vision landing page to L4 with a native Foundry Sight Capability finder: a discipline filter over the program's own capability grid with a live count readout, rendered as a shared element across the home, playbook and evidence pages. The lever reuses the local feature-tile icon svg assets and the image1.png/image2.jpeg/image3.webp inspection-evidence split images while preserving the React/CRA landing page, hero video modal and newsletter CTA.
